newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary boosts housing construction in H1 1996.
newsitem.headline: Hungary boosts housing construction in H1 1996.

text.p: Hungarians finished the construction of 8,592 flats in the first half of this year, up from 7,545 in the same period of 1995, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Thursday in a statement.
Housing construction has been boosted substantially by increased housing subsidies at the end of 1994, the KSH said.
But Hungarians already applied for 31 percent fewer permits for the construction of flats in the first half of 1996 than in the first six months of 1995, it added.
Individuals built 93 percent of the new flats in the first half of this year, compared with 87 percent in the same period last year and 52 percent in the late 1980s, the KSH said.
